verdict.rationale: CUDA Toolkit docs note that GPU-accelerated applications can be developed and deployed across desktop workstations, enterprise data centers, cloud platforms and supercomputers, implying headless/server operation, and MIG allows isolated GPU instances suitable for automated multi-tenant workloads. However there is no explicit mention of CI/CD pipelines, headless driver installation, or automation tooling for this specific GPU. missing for 10: explicit CI/automation documentation, headless-mode setup guides, driver/automation scripting examples.
